_comment: Template for config.json (which is git-ignored). Copy to config.json and fill in the <FILL IN ...> values. Secrets/IDs are placeholders; the structural tuning below is sensible defaults. Any remaining <FILL IN trips the digest's Step 0 abort guard, so an unfilled config won't run.
slack_channel: <FILL IN: Slack channel ID — fallback delivery only>
gchat_webhook_url: <FILL IN: Google Chat incoming-webhook URL (primary delivery; embeds key+token — secret)>

apps_script.url: <FILL IN: deployed Apps Script web-app /exec URL>
apps_script.secret: <FILL IN: shared secret gating the web app — treat as a password>
